name: universal-remote
description: Lightweight universal remote PWA and local gateway.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w gateway" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w gateway
scripts.check: node ./node_modules/typescript-7/bin/tsc -p packages/protocol --noEmit && node ./node_modules/typescript-7/bin/tsc -p gateway --noEmit && node ./node_modules/typescript-7/bin/tsc -p web --noEmit
